title: Promptness of a Damage Decision and the Share Recharged
content:
On a Car Rental Rate Classes rental, how promptly the damage was decided sets the share of the excess borne
that the renter is recharged. The days to decision are the calendar days from the date the renter returned
the vehicle to the date the rental desk decided the last damage assessment it approved on the rental.

| Days to decision | Share recharged |
| --- | --- |
| the damage was decided on the day the vehicle came back | the whole of the amount, which is 100 per cent |
| decided within 8 days of the vehicle coming back | 90 per cent |

Where the damage was decided on the day the vehicle came back the whole of the amount is recharged, and
where it was decided within 8 days of the vehicle coming back 90 per cent is recharged. Where it was decided
later than 8 days after the vehicle came back, neither of these shares applies to it.

## The day count at each edge

- Decided on the return day itself, the days to decision are nothing and the first row answers.
- Decided 1 day after the vehicle came back, the first row is passed and the second answers, giving
  90 per cent.
- Decided 8 days after the vehicle came back, the second row still answers, because 8 days is within 8 days.
- Decided 9 days after the vehicle came back, neither row is reached.

## Which assessment fixes the date

The date taken is the date the desk decided the last damage assessment it approved on the rental. Where the
desk approved two assessments on that rental, the later decision date is the one the days to decision are
counted to; an assessment the desk did not approve fixes no date here.
